# Intergrax

> Agent OS and Harness AI runtime for building, orchestrating, experimenting with, and validating specialized AI agents in Python.

Intergrax is a **production-grade Harness AI platform** — not a chatbot or single agent. It provides a four-tier stack (Platform → Nexus Agent OS → Agents → Applications), governed runtime (policy, tools, skills, context, trace), and a capability model: Integration → Tool → Skill → Agent.

**Repository:** https://github.com/jakbuczarnecki/intergrax-ai  
**Documentation index (canonical):** README.md#documentation-index  
**License:** Proprietary — see LICENSE

## When to use Intergrax

- Build **specialized AI agents** on a shared Harness instead of one-off LLM scripts
- **Experiment rapidly** — idea to first traced Nexus run in under one hour
- Orchestrate **multi-agent graphs** with policy, human-in-the-loop, and observability
- Extend via **pip-installable plugins** (integrations, tools, skills)
- Deploy **Tier-3 application hosts** that compose agents into products
- Evaluate platform maturity against an **ideal Harness AI reference model** (L0–L4 gates)

## Implementation & status

- docs/INTERGRAX_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md — **platform** phase tracker, gates, maintenance queue (§6.1); **Phase CRIT-V (Band 2ak) Done** (24/24); not product/agent deployment plans
- Tool catalog: **172** tools · **42** bundles (T-EXPAND T13 / CRIT-V Done) — docs/TOOLS.md
- Harness platform: **complete** (§6.1 maintenance; **Phase CRIT-V** Done)
- Regression gate: `uv run pytest -m gate -q`
- Business agents (Phase K): K.1/K.2 deferred; **Local Knowledge Workspace (LKW)** — applications/local_workspace_application/ARCHITECTURE.md · plan §6.3a LKW.*

## Documentation boundary

- docs/intergrax_runtime_architecture.md + docs/INTERGRAX_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md = **Harness AI / Agent OS platform** (run environments on the runtime)
- applications/<product>/ARCHITECTURE.md + IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md = **business environment** (product)
- agents/<name>/ARCHITECTURE.md = **business agent** (domain capability)
- Do not treat platform canon as the deployment plan for a specific product or agent

## Quick start commands

```bash
uv run pytest -m gate -q
python -m intergrax.scaffold new-agent my_agent --capability domain.action
uv run intergrax doctor
```
